name: Apple M5 Pro (MacBook Pro 14-inch, 2026)
memory_bandwidth_basis: Apple tech specs: '307GB/s memory bandwidth' for the M5 Pro with 15-core CPU / 16-core GPU; configurable to M5 Pro with 18-core CPU / 20-core GPU at the same 307GB/s. Unified-memory bandwidth, package-level, shared with the CPU.
notes: M5 Pro: 16-core or 20-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, up to 64GB unified memory. The 307GB/s bandwidth is a significant increase over M4 Pro's 273GB/s. For local LLM inference, 64GB unified memory can hold a 70B model at 4-bit (~35GB weights) with substantial room for KV cache. The 307GB/s bandwidth yields roughly 10-15 tokens/sec for a 70B model at 4-bit. The M5 Pro is the mid-range Apple Silicon option for serious local LLM work.
